hi everyone! i’m ayaan, undergrad playing around with lean tooling
built a small thing called ProofLens: ProofLens
you can step through tactics, see goals change, and view proofs as graphs
takes ~40–50s to load rn (sorry, working on it)
i am also thinking of adding a trainer mode to guess next tactics
would love any feedback esp what would make this actually useful
Hi! I think this is somewhat similar to PaperProof. You might find it helpful as a reference.
